steps.title: Async HTTP — aiohttp (Advanced)
steps.code:
# pip install aiohttp
import asyncio
import aiohttp

async def fetch():
    async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as session:
        async with session.get('https://httpbin.org/delay/1') as res:
            return await res.text()[:50]

result = asyncio.run(fetch())
print("Partial response:", result)

steps.title: CLI Calculator (argparse)
steps.code:
import argparse

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('x', type=float)
parser.add_argument('op')
parser.add_argument('y', type=float)
args = parser.parse_args()

ops = {'+': lambda a,b: a+b, '-': lambda a,b: a-b}
result = ops.get(args.op, lambda a,b: 'Invalid')(args.x, args.y)
print(f"{args.x} {args.op} {args.y} = {result}")

import json, os
FILE = "todo.json"

def load(): return json.load(open(FILE)) if os.path.exists(FILE) else []
def save(todos): json.dump(todos, open(FILE, 'w'), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

todos = load()
todos.append({"task": "ফ্লাটার শেখা", "done": False})
save(todos)
print("Task added.")
